create_PipelineQuantizationConfig: create a PipelineQuantizationConfig with a quant_backend and quant_kwargs for on-the-fly pipeline quantization
build_PipelineQuantizationConfig_mapping: build a PipelineQuantizationConfig using quant_mapping to specify per-module quantization configs
validate_PipelineQuantizationConfig: validate PipelineQuantizationConfig init args including backend availability and config signature matching
resolve_quant_config: resolve the quantization config for a specific pipeline module name and backend type
get_quant_config_list: get the available quantization config mappings from both diffusers and transformers backends
